short_description: Apply Spec Driven Development with explicit validation and safety boundaries.
description: Plan, implement, or review spec driven development work in an existing codebase with compatibility, security, and verification controls. Use when the user explicitly requests spec driven development work.

requires: Local tools appropriate to the requested task
An authorized SandBase connection only for optional external capabilities

install.prompt: Use $spec-driven-development to complete and verify this Spec Driven Development task.
install.cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill spec-driven-development --agent codex
install.global_cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill spec-driven-development --agent codex --global

notes: Optional external calls use dynamic SandBase inspection and paid-call confirmation.

endpoints.summary: Inspect live schemas, limits, and pricing.
Recover recent status and observed cost.
Check balance before an approved batch.
